╔════════════════════════════════╗
║           tsync 1.3            ║
║   Copyright: Aytek Ustundag    ║
╚════════════════════════════════╝

Usage
  tsync scan <project.csproj> [--catalog <server|client>] [--include <glob>] [--exclude <glob>] [--json] [--build-only] [--no-build]
  tsync pot <project.csproj> [--catalog <server|client>] [--include <glob>] [--exclude <glob>] [--output <path> ...] [--no-build]
  tsync po <project.csproj> [--catalog <server|client>] [--culture <culture>] [--include <glob>] [--exclude <glob>] [--output <path> ...] [--overwrite] [--copy-source] [--no-build]
  tsync resx <project.csproj> [--culture <culture>] [--output <path> ...] [--overwrite] [--copy-source] [--no-build]
  tsync sync <project.csproj> --format <pot|po|resx> [--catalog <server|client>] [other generation options]
  tsync json <client.po> --output <directory> [--culture <culture>] [--hash] [--manifest <path>] [--check]
  Source scan/generation commands also accept --artifacts-path <directory> to isolate and reuse build/Razor outputs.

Client source opt-ins (require --catalog client):
  --typescript  Include .ts, .mts, and .cts files. Declaration files (*.d.ts, *.d.mts, *.d.cts) are excluded by default.
  --tsx         Include .tsx files, including translation calls inside JSX expressions and attributes.
  Use either or both flags with scan, pot, po, or sync. Default scanning remains JavaScript (.js/.mjs).
  Files outside wwwroot require --include globs. Vendor, node_modules, minified, and declaration files are excluded by default.

Catalogs
  server  Extract explicit IStringLocalizer calls from C# and compiled Razor (default).
          Follow source-defined keys through variables, model properties, metadata, and constructors; unresolved runtime keys warn.
  client  Extract explicit t('...') and i18n.t('...') calls from application JavaScript.

Examples
  tsync scan ./MyWebApp.csproj
  tsync scan ./MyWebApp.csproj --catalog client --typescript --tsx --include "src/**/*.ts" --include "src/**/*.tsx" --no-build
  tsync po ./M
[truncated]
